summary: The official Tuesday ATL-GB injury report is now published, resolving the prior archive's pending participation state: Jayden Reed, Aaron Banks and Zach Bako-Bewele were estimated DNP again; Anthony Belton newly appeared as limited; Donovan Jennings improved to limited; A.J. Terrell Jr. is on IR; Michael Penix Jr., Brian Robinson Jr. and Tua Tagovailoa were full. This is a material information update but does not create a price-adjusted NFL player-prop bet. Current multi-book line shopping shows Jordan Love passing yards as low as 225.5 O-110 at Fanatics, Christian Watson receiving yards as low as 64.5 O-114 at BetParx / 64.5 O-115 at BetRivers, and Watson receptions U4.5 as high as +105 at DraftKings/Bovada. Love O225.5 is the strongest early-week lean, but fresh Green Bay OL/WR uncertainty is not fully reflected in several projection sources and the conservative estimated edge remains in the 2-4% bucket. Watson receiving is only a small projection cushion relative to a high-variance market, while Watson receptions has meaningful model-vs-market disagreement plus Jayden Reed's absence can increase target volume. Wait for Wednesday participation and fresh repricing rather than force Tuesday action.
